caption: The video captures a turquoise indoor pool viewed through a wet glass pane scattered with droplets, where several penguins float at the surface. In the lower-left foreground a large penguin is seen half-submerged through the waterline, its dark back, white belly and splayed flippers visible as its body drifts slowly toward the left edge. A second penguin swims in the middle of the frame with its head and upper back above the surface. The middle penguin continuously paddles, its head rising and dipping while its body rotates slightly and translates gradually leftward, with ripples and a small splash forming around its neck. The foreground penguin's flippers shift from a wide-spread paddle posture to a more folded, trailing position. Behind them, two background penguin heads bob up and down, the upper-left one moving slowly to the right. Across the clip the waterline tilts more steeply from left to right and the droplet pattern on the glass shifts slightly, while no penguin fully submerges or leaves the frame during this excerpt.
relations: Foreground penguin drifts leftward, its flippers shifting from a splayed paddle posture to a folded trailing position.
Middle penguin continuously paddles, its head rising and dipping while translating leftward, creating ripples and neck splashes.
Background penguin heads bob vertically, with the upper-left head slowly moving rightward across the frame.
The waterline tilts more steeply from left to right, and the droplet pattern on the glass shifts.
